description: Hochwasser-Risikogebiete Weser und Emmer (Landkreis Hameln-Pyrmont) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by hameln-pyrmont.maps.arcgis.com. Modelling of flood risk areas according to the EC-HWRM-RL and § 73 WHG for the flood scenarios HQ5, HQ10, HQ25, HQ50, HQ100 and HQextrem, developed as part of the flood protection plan Oberweser. Data include HQ Boundaries, HQ Depths and Drain Behavior of Weser and Emmer. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Flood risk areas Weser and Emmer (district Hameln-Pyrmont)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
